_purpose: Constellation Track B, steps B2 and B4. schema-v3 overlay for ASML. Successor to v0.4. Fills drivers.otherOpAssetsModel from the FY2024 US GAAP balance sheet (tight split) and fills the scaling driver in all three cases by a stated rule. Every other forward value remains null by design and the engine will still refuse to compute. Nothing here is inferred beyond the rule recorded in each source string.
_fillOrder: 1) scenarios.discount from the W1 band produced by the /collect run. 2) scenarios.netDebt. 3) the three case path blocks. 4) sources for each. 5) triggers.

drivers.baseYearSource: model.years[-1] (the engine reads it from the schema-v2 block; do not restate it here)
drivers.unitNote: All currency drivers are in model.unit. ASP drivers are model.unit per system, so units x ASP lands in model.unit directly.

revenueModel._note: Installed Base Management (service plus upgrades) enters as a direct revenue line, not a unit tree. Metrology/inspection is folded into duv unless split out in a later registry version; if the schema-v2 revenue line includes it, the duv term will absorb the residual and the fit should be checked against the base year.

definitions.label: Installed Base Management revenue (service and upgrades)
Gross margin on the costOfSales line. House GP = revenue - costOfSales, depreciation stated separately (SKILL section 2). See extraction rule E1
R&D plus SG&A as a share of revenue, mapped to the sga line. sga is the only line between GP and EBITDA (SKILL section 2)
Depreciation as a share of prior-year PPE
Capex-incl as a share of revenue. House capex is delta(net ppe) plus depreciation, i.e. gross capex (SKILL section 2)

Operating working capital as a share of revenue. OWC = (operatingCash + otherCurrentAssets) - (accountsPayable + otherNonInterestLiab). Can be negative: customer prepayments sit in otherNonInterestLiab
Effective tax rate applied to EBIT for NOPLAT
Scaling remainder of other operating assets, as a share of revenue. The non-scaling stock is held in drivers.otherOpAssetsModel.nonScalingStock and does not appear here.

cashPolicy.source: default: all cash treated as excess, pending an operating/excess split from /collect (open item E3)
cashPolicy._note: Operating cash = revenue * operatingCashPctRevenue. It sits inside OWC and therefore inside invested capital. The remainder is excess cash and is netted against longTermDebt in the valuation bridge. At 0.0 the bridge is arithmetically identical to SKILL section 2 (netDebt = longTermDebt - operatingCash), so no per-share number moves; only invested capital, ROIC and EVA change. This is the resolution of open item X1.

otherOpAssetsModel.nonScalingStockSource: FY2024 US GAAP consolidated balance sheet, non-current assets: goodwill 4,588.6 + other intangible assets net 621.3 + equity method investments 903.0 = 6,112.9. Tight split: only balances that do not move with revenue. Reconciliation: total non-current assets 17,852.2 less PPE 6,846.8 = 11,005.4, equal to the model line and to the sum of the eight components. Corroboration: independent OLS of otherOperatingAssets on revenue FY2020-24 gives an intercept of 6,757.9, within 9.5 percent of this composed figure. Behaviour check: this bucket moved -137.0 in FY2024 (goodwill flat, intangibles amortising, equity method flat), which is how a fixed stock behaves. Deferred tax (1,940.7) and loans receivable (1,456.6) were deliberately EXCLUDED: together they grew +458.8 in FY2024 alone, so freezing them would assume that growth stops.
otherOpAssetsModel._note: Under stock_plus_ratio, otherOperatingAssets = nonScalingStock + revenue * driver. nonScalingStock is the portion of the FY2024 balance of 11,005.4 that does not scale with revenue (goodwill, intangibles, equity investments, deferred tax and similar), in model units. The driver then carries only the scaling remainder. Fall back to kind=flat if the split is not to hand: that holds the whole line constant, avoids the error, and gives up the operating portion's genuine scaling.

scenarios._supersedes: the single-year Gordon in front-end slice 4

discount._note_waccByCase: Empty means the W1 mid band is held constant across bear/base/bull and WACC is swung only in the tornado. To couple the rate to the case instead, set {"bear":"waccHigh","base":"waccMid","bull":"waccLow"} and record the reason (unresolved convention C5).
discount._note_terminal: Set terminalMethod to fade_then_gordon and fadeYears > 0 to fade the final explicit growth rate down to terminalGrowth before capitalising.

netDebt._note: OPTIONAL OVERRIDE. Leave value null and the engine derives net debt as longTermDebt minus excess cash, where excess cash follows drivers.cashPolicy. Nulls here do not block.

bear.narrative: WFE downcycle, China revenue share bites, High-NA adoption slips right.

sources.other_op_assets_scaling_pct_revenue: PROVISIONAL, rule-based, not researched. Rule: base = the FY2024 observed scaling remainder of 17.31 percent (4,892.5 on revenue 28,262.9), held flat, i.e. no assumed improvement from the base year the engine starts from. Cases span by the single observed year-on-year move of 3.45pp (FY2023 was 13.86 percent: 4,892.5 becomes 3,820.5 on revenue 27,557.7). Bull is the low ratio (less capital consumed, higher FOCF), bear the high. LIMIT: two observations only. FY2020-22 component detail would settle whether 13.86 to 17.31 is a range or a trend. Revise before stamping.

scenarios._note_triggers: Nulls here are reported as unarmed but do not block a run. Each armed trigger needs a threshold, a direction, the case it flips to, and a playbook. Resolutions accumulate over time and are the calibration loop.
_openItems: T1 statutory 25.80 vs implied effective 13.7-18.6; the forward tax_rate driver is free of this, slices 1-4 are not
E2 projected block does not drive interest or tax lines
E3 operatingCash is total cash, not an operating subset
E4 FY2024 reclassification inside otherCurrentAssets: current finance receivables 1,379.2 -> 82.6 and current tax assets 1,001.2 -> 283.6. Both feed OWC and are part of the O3 swing
O2 anchor paths on FY2022-FY2024, not FY2020
O3 owc_pct_revenue is a swing not a level: -2.96 / -6.80 / +4.04 / -3.68. Fill from the three-year mean and put the swing in the tornado
O4 note 26 loans receivable grew 56.8 percent on revenue up 2.5 percent and is 56 percent of the FY2024 otherOperatingAssets step. Read the note before stamping
O5 the scaling remainder k rests on two observations (13.86 FY2023, 17.31 FY2024). Not settled
